verdict.rationale: Alacritty has a programmatic surface (IPC via `alacritty msg`), so a buyer could fairly ask about an API reference, but the evidence shows no interactive reference or runnable examples. The docs are static feature and config pages, and probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs and llms.txt all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
